description: This file defines a RecyclerView adapter class 'VideoBrowseAdapter' for displaying a list of videos in a browsing UI. It handles binding video data to views, and user interaction such as clicking, focusing, and key events for remote control activation.

classes.name: VideoBrowseAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView adapter for displaying a list of VideoItem objects with click and focus handling.

classes.name: VideoBrowseAdapter.VideoViewHolder
classes.description: A ViewHolder class holding references to item views, specifically the title TextView.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates the item view layout and creates a VideoViewHolder.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the list.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds video data to ViewHolder and sets up focus, click, and key event listeners on the item view.
